You will follow the transmitted heading and dock at Imperial station HM7-R, where your physical credentials will be examined.|Communication from HM7-R to ''The Emperor's Vision''|<ref name="OSG">{{FFG|story=Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta}}</ref>}}
